```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
```

## Overview

This website visualizes race and ethnicity data across census tracts in Sarasota County, Florida, using the 2022 5-year American Community Survey (ACS).

```{r}
#| label: race-plot
sarasota_race <- read_rds("data/sarasota_race.rds")

sarasota_race |>
  filter(variable != "total") |>
  group_by(variable) |>
  summarize(total_pop = sum(estimate, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(variable = str_to_title(variable)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = total_pop, y = reorder(variable, total_pop))) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Population by Race and Ethnicity",
    subtitle = "Sarasota County, Florida",
    x = "Total Population",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
